assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready original pixel-art game character sprite atlas; clean cutout assets, not a screenshot.
Primary request: Create one PORTRAIT 1024x1536 PNG with a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Arrange EXACTLY 12 isolated sprites in an invisible equal 3-column by 4-row grid. No labels, no borders, no gridlines, no other objects. Each sprite sits centered fully within its cell with wide transparent margins; nothing touches or crosses cell boundaries.
Style: deliberately coarse authentic low-resolution pixel art. Think sprites originally only 32–40 logical pixels tall, enlarged by exact nearest-neighbor: obvious LARGE SQUARE PIXELS, chunky stepped silhouettes, thick black pixel outlines, very few large clusters, flat 2–3 hard shades per material and a tiny palette. Creepy-cute big heads and very small bodies. No fine detail, no antialiasing, no gradients, no painted textures, no smooth curves, no modern high-resolution illustration.
Rows 1 and 2 depict the SAME original hero, facing RIGHT in all upright poses: a little cellar wanderer with a pale peach round head, huge dark sad eyes, blue tear marks, a modest dull blue patched tunic, grey shorts, and a little rusty cleaver. Keep the exact same identity, body proportions, face and clothing in all six poses. Row 1 left-to-right: idle; attack windup lifting cleaver; strike extending cleaver right. Row 2 left-to-right: guard defensive crouch; hurt recoiling; death lying horizontally on the ground, head oriented to the right. Non-graphic.
Rows 3 and 4 depict the SAME original rival, facing LEFT in all upright poses: a round grey cellar goblin with a rag hood, large black eyes, two tiny cream teeth, a short brown vest, and stubby fists. Keep the same identity and proportions in all six poses. Row 3 left-to-right: idle; attack windup; strike punching left. Row 4 left-to-right: guard; hurt recoiling; death lying horizontally on the ground, head oriented to the left. Non-graphic.
Constraints: original subjects only; no Isaac, no Azazel, no copied game characters or logos. These should resemble a tiny-scale creepy basement roguelike in visual grammar only. Cream highlights, never pure white. No UI, no text or watermark. Background pixels MUST have actual zero alpha: do not draw a white background, a grey background or any checkerboard pattern. Preserve all black outlines fully opaque. Only the 12 separated sprite silhouettes contain visible pixels.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready original pixel-art item icon atlas for a creepy-cute basement roguelike.
Primary request: Create a LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 PNG with a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background, exactly 12 isolated icons in an invisible equal 4-column by 3-row grid. Center each icon in its cell with wide transparent margins; every icon fully contained and separated.
Exact reading order: row 1 rusty cleaver, dented grey shield, blue tear, gold eye; row 2 green poison bottle, round black bomb, red heart, gold coin; row 3 pink healing bottle, tooth charm, crooked paper crown, yellow star. Exactly one of each, no extra objects.
Style: extremely simple authentic low-resolution pixel icons originally 16–24 logical pixels wide and tall then enlarged nearest-neighbor. Obvious very LARGE SQUARE PIXELS; full thick black stepped pixel outlines. Flat hard 2–3 tone shading and tiny palette. Very simple bold silhouettes and chunky clusters, no fine detail. Creepy-cute mood. Cream rather than pure-white highlights. These are ORIGINAL generic items, not copies of existing game assets.
Constraints: no labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, borders, gridlines, shadows outside the silhouettes, gradients, antialiasing, painterly texture or high-resolution illustration. The actual PNG must have transparent alpha outside each icon. Do NOT paint a checkerboard, white or grey backdrop. Only the 12 separated icon silhouettes contain visible pixels.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original opaque pixel-art game arena background.
Primary request: Create one WIDE 16:9 1536x864 image of a sparse enclosed brown basement chamber viewed top-down with a slightly front-facing view of the rear stone wall. Clean environment only, no UI screenshot. The rectangular room fills the image. Thick stone walls run along ALL FOUR edges, black outer corners, dark doors centered in the rear/top wall, left wall and right wall. The floor is bare dusty muted brown and occupies the center 70%, which is completely empty and clear for game actors. Put only a few tiny cracks and rocks by the perimeter. Keep the center uniform and calm.
Style: authentic deliberately coarse low-resolution pixel art as if made at about 320x180 logical resolution then enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor. Clearly visible chunky square pixels, thick stepped outlines, tiny 12-color brown/taupe palette, flat hard pixel shading, simple large clusters. The chamber has a creepy, modest cellar mood and sparse composition.
Constraints: original room design; no proprietary game designs, characters, logos, text, HUD, cards, items, foreground objects, people or creatures. Absolutely no objects or clutter in the center. No bloom, smooth gradients, antialiasing, photorealism, painterly detail or high-resolution textures. OPAQUE image, not transparent.
